searchText: Can one of the authors of 1559 please review <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3031>? can we add GASPREMIUM and BASEFEE? (maybe as a separate EIP though) I'm not opposed to either opcode, though I will argue against the term `GASPREMIUM` as I believe it to be mildly deceitful wording that exists for public relations reasons, and I am generally against public relation stuff bleeding into code. Or to put it more specifically, I think MINER_BRIBE more accurately describes what that variable is, and we should prefer a more accurate variable name over a less accurate variable name. BRIBE has connotation of illegal deed so it is wrong maybe MINER_PREMIUM but then it is PREMIUM so GASPREMIUM Miner Incentive? Hmm, I suppose bribe does come with negative connotation. I would accept an alternative word there that is not negative but still clearly asserts that "this is the money you are going to pay to the miner in order to incentivize them to include your transaction". I like `MINER_INCENTIVE`. MINER_TIP? I'm not a fan of tip, because it isn't really optional at all. Tip implies that it you can give it or not, and the miners will still serve you. `MINER_FEE` would work for me, I think that aligns pretty closely with what it is. I'm also against bribe, as it feels needlessly confrontational. Not a hill I wanted to die on, bu tif the conversation is already happening 🙂 IMO `MINER FEE` fits well with the other terms 👍 `MINER_FEE` sticks with current naming conventions. `MINER_PAYMENT` carries similar tone. miner_reward, since you reward the miner for helping you out how does it change when EIP-1559 is applied to eth 2.0 and there are no miners anymore?
